records.name: Geyin.az
records.tagline: AI-powered fashion marketplace with 11 autonomous agents
records.description: Geyin.az is Azerbaijan's first AI-powered fashion marketplace. 11 autonomous AI agents run 24/7 producing multilingual content in 4 languages (AZ/TR/RU/EN) with zero hallucination. Smart Upload lets vendors photograph a product and AI generates names, descriptions, categories in seconds. Visual search finds similar products from any photo. Built on Django, Google Cloud Run, and Gemini 2.5 Flash. The entire AI agent army costs $55/month.

records.name: sinc-LLM
records.tagline: Turn any prompt into 6 Nyquist bands. Cut LLM costs 97%.
records.description: Free sinc-LLM prompt transformer. Apply the Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem to your LLM prompts. Decompose raw prompts into 6 specification bands for faithful reconstruction.

records.name: Mine Market
records.tagline: AI-powered marketplace for mining projects worldwide
records.description: Mine Market is an AI-powered mining intelligence platform. We use Claude's API to generate instant geology reports, scan opportunities across 3,000+ government data sources, automate due diligence, buil pitch decks, and analyse drillhole data. Plus a global marketplace to buy, sell, and list mining projects for free. 10 tools built for buyers, investors, explorers, geologists, and brokers.

records.name: CellSentry
records.tagline: Local AI that audits your spreadsheets — data never leaves
records.description: CellSentry scans Excel files for formula errors, sesitive data, and structured information — running enirely on your machine. Drop a file, three engines rn at once: • Spreadsheet Audit: 23 rules + loca 1.5B AI model • PII Detection: find and redact SSN, credit cards, emails • Data Extraction: parse invoces into JSON/CSV No cloud. No account. No subscripion. Free and open source (MIT). Mac + Windows.

records.name: SettlThat
records.tagline: An app that ends arguments, let the crowd decide who's right
records.description: Me and my friends argue about EVERYTHING — sports, money, random takes — and it always turns into “I’m right / you’re wrong” with no actual answer. So I built something called SettlThat. Basically: You post a question Real people vote on it You get an answer in minutes Example: “Is $100k enough to feel rich?” “Who wins: prime LeBron or Jordan?” “Is texting first a bad look?”

records.name: Caferesto
records.tagline: Run your restaurant operations in minutes, no setup required
records.description: Free POS demo for cafés and restaurants. Manage tables, orders, products and sales reports — no login required, all data stored in your browser. Point of sale system demo.

records.name: ResuMaker
records.tagline: Research-backed AI professional resume builder.
records.description: Upload your resume once, generate targeted versions for every job application. AI-powered matching and tailoring. Every change, every detail traced backed to research-backed insights.

records.name: payflo
records.tagline: Convertissez plus de devis et éliminez les retards de…
records.description: Plus de CA. Sans faire plus de devis. Payflo fait gagner vos devis et encaisse le paiement le jour même. Plan gratuit.

records.name: ReleaseRun
records.tagline: Stop reading changelogs. Start understanding releases.
records.description: 84 free browser tools for developers. No login, no paywall, no install. Covers: dependency health (npm, PyPI, Go, Cargo, Maven, Composer, NuGet, RubyGems), security scanning (Dockerfile, GitHub Actions, K8s YAML, Terraform), EOL checking (Node, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker), and utilities (HTTP headers analyzer, PromQL builder, Uptime SLA calculator, CVE dashboard). Built for engineers who want fast answers about their stack without reading changelogs.
